business_overview.one_sentence: Lianlian DigiTech provides global and domestic digital payment services, value-added services such as virtual card and corporate wallet services, and small property rental operations.

segments.name: Global payment
segments.business_substance: Cross-border and overseas payment services; TPV reached RMB452.4 billion in 2025.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue breakdown

segments.name: Domestic payment
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue breakdown

segments.name: Value-added services
segments.business_substance: Virtual card, corporate wallet and related business or technology services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue breakdown

segments.name: Others
segments.business_substance: Primarily property rental from self-owned properties.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue breakdown

business_overview.revenue_model: Service fees from digital payment processing, value-added service fees, interest income on customer segregated accounts, and minor rental income.
business_notes: The company is a payment and fintech infrastructure operator; customer segregated funds and merchant payables are operating/client balances, not excess cash.
2025 reported profit was dominated by gains from disposal and dilution of equity interests, not recurring operating profit.

non_recurring_items.item: Gains on disposal of investments accounted for using the equity method
non_recurring_items.business_substance: One-off gain on disposal of part of LianTong equity interest to American Express.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, Note 9 Other gains/(losses) - net

non_recurring_items.item: Dilution gains resulted in deemed disposal of interests in associates
non_recurring_items.business_substance: One-off dilution gain after American Express capital increase in LianTong.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, Note 9 Other gains/(losses) - net

non_recurring_items.item: Gains on disposal of a subsidiary
non_recurring_items.business_substance: One-off gain from DFX Advance financing transaction and deconsolidation.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, Note 9 Other gains/(losses) - net

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value losses of financial assets at FVPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value movement on FVPL financial assets.

funds_assets.business_substance: Unrestricted cash and cash equivalents after excluding funds segregated for customers and restricted cash.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Balance Sheet and Note 24

funds_assets.item: Funds segregated for customers and restricted cash
funds_assets.business_substance: Customer funds awaiting disbursement, service fees not yet withdrawn from segregated accounts, expedited-settlement deposits and performance guarantees for payment business.
Principal-guaranteed funds investing mainly in foreign money funds with short terms.

funds_assets.item: Long-term investments measured at amortized cost
funds_assets.business_substance: Certificates of deposit with fixed rate of 2.15% and initial term over 12 months.

operating_assets.business_substance: Amounts due from customers for services performed in ordinary course.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Balance Sheet and Note 20

operating_assets.item: Prepayments, other receivables and other current assets
operating_assets.business_substance: Prepaid expenses, VAT recoverable, deposits for payment channels and rentals, and advances paid on behalf of customers.

investment_assets.business_substance: Unlisted equity investments, treasury investments and listed equity securities.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Balance Sheet and Note 21(a)

investment_assets.business_substance: Strategic unlisted equity investment in NetsUnion Clearing Corporation.

investment_assets.item: Investments accounted for using the equity method
investment_assets.business_substance: Associates including retained interests after LianTong and DFX transactions.
Self-owned properties used for rental; some assets pledged for bank borrowings.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Balance Sheet and Note 31(a)

other_assets.business_substance: Office, equipment and related operating fixed assets.
Leased operating premises and land use rights.
Computer software and related intangible assets.
Deferred tax assets remaining after major reversal in 2025.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Balance Sheet and Note 33

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Pledged long-term bank borrowings plus current long-term portion and short-term unsecured bank borrowings.
Operating lease liabilities; treated through operating cash/profit quality rather than 100% debt deduction for continuing operation.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, Consolidated Balance Sheet and Note 14(b)

operating_liabilities.item: Payables to merchants and other customers
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Funds processed by the Group and awaiting settlement with merchants and customers.
Unsecured supplier payables, usually paid within 90 days.

investment_liabilities.item: Payables for acquisition of investments accounted for using the equity method
investment_liabilities.business_substance: Investment acquisition payable included in accruals and other payables.

years.assessment: Reported profit is dominated by one-off disposal and dilution gains; operating cash flow is positive only after RMB223.0 million interest received.
Loss-making year with negative operating cash flow.
Five-year financial highlights show a large loss; detailed cash flow was not extracted from this annual report.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: The 2025 net profit is not a sustainable profit base. After stripping one-off gains, recurring operating profit is small and cash conversion remains weak because cash used in operations was negative before interest received.

evidence.value: Annual Report 2025 audited by PricewaterhouseCoopers, signed 2026-03-26
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, Independent Auditor's Report and financial statements

gaps: Annual report does not split unrestricted cash by parent company, offshore holding company, Mainland operating subsidiaries, payment license entity or VIE cash availability.
Detailed 2023 cash flow and capital expenditure were not extracted from the 2025 annual report; only five-year profit highlights were used for 2023 loss context.
The report does not quantify what portion of service fees inside segregated accounts had not been withdrawn at year end.
